meta.title: Vendor Code is optional at invite

steps.note: Open a create screen from which the buyer can access the invitation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title required to continue on the create screen.
Apply a template so the event setup controls, including participants, are available.
Add the minimum line item needed for the create screen to be usable.
Complete the pricing sheet before inviting the vendor.

args.goal: open the buyer's Invite Vendor side drawer, fill all required fields while leaving Vendor Code empty, click Next and then Invite, and stop when the screen shows the invitation success message with Vendor Code blank

steps.note: Perform the manual invite flow and verify on screen that omitting Vendor Code does not block the invitation.
Assert that the invitation produced a success notification.
